lines.text: The king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah because he had heard about Hezekiah's illness.
Hezekiah showed the envoys his silver, gold, spices, precious oil, and armory, and nothing in his palace was hidden.
The prophet Nathan asked where the men came from, and Hezekiah said they had seen everything.
The LORD's word was that everything in the palace would be carried off, and some of Hezekiah's soldiers taken away.
Hezekiah called the LORD's word good, and after he rested with his fathers, his son Manasseh reigned.
